identity.name: MisfitPIXELS
identity.notes: MisfitPIXELS ships per-token avatar files in VRM, FBX, GLB and GLTF formats at the misfitpixels.xyz CDN endpoint assets/misfits/01_100/{id}/MisfitPixels.{ext}. The sample URL (token 02) was structurally validated as a valid GLB 2.0 binary with the VRM 0.x extension payload. The catalog currently holds 1 sample URL; expanding the template to enumerate every token requires a probe pass over 1,000 tokens, which is outside this incremental pass. The inventory is recorded as a complete publicly-accessible multi-format avatar lane with the verified sample URL serving as the canonical reference.

source_evidence.note: First 4 KiB and full JSON chunk confirmed as GLB 2.0 with the VRM 0.x extension payload; total file length 146,868 bytes.
Moralis evidence confirms the on-chain token metadata publishes per-token VRM/FBX/GLB/GLTF URLs.

evidence.note: Official MisfitPIXELS site documents the per-token avatar download endpoint and the multi-format (VRM, FBX, GLB, GLTF) issuer.
Sample URL proved to be a valid GLB 2.0 binary with the VRM 0.x extension payload.
Moralis confirms the on-chain token metadata publishes the per-token VRM URL.

avatar_inventory.note: The catalog records one verified sample VRM token as the canonical avatar asset. The full per-token enumeration is delegated to the existing template-driven probe path; the structural validation of the sample URL establishes the avatar-ready lane.

file_access.note: The MisfitPIXELS CDN is publicly addressable without authentication; the on-chain token metadata publishes the URL directly. Owners and non-owners alike can fetch the avatar model.

evidence.note: Official site documents the public 3D avatar download endpoint and the multi-format issuer.
Sample URL is publicly reachable without authentication and returns a valid VRM file.
Moralis confirms the token metadata publishes the per-token VRM URL directly without authentication.
Per-token VRM files are served from the project's public CDN.

project_status.note: MisfitPIXELS remains an active collection project. The on-chain mint is closed but the 3D avatar delivery and metadata service continue to serve live VRM/FBX/GLB/GLTF files for every minted token.

evidence.note: Official site remains online, the 3D avatar delivery and metadata service continue to publish per-token assets.
Moralis confirms the on-chain token metadata service is live.

ip_rights.summary: MisfitPIXELS documents explicit per-token non-exclusive IP rights to the likeness of the artwork. The license is non-exclusive and tied to NFT ownership: each Misfit token grants its holder the non-exclusive IP rights to the likeness of the artwork it represents.

evidence.note: Official on-chain token metadata states: 'Each Misfit token comes with non-exclusive IP rights to the likeness of the artwork.'
Moralis captured the on-chain metadata description that documents the non-exclusive IP rights grant.
